rules_locked.weekly_highlights: Target slide window only. Maximum 4–6 rider-facing events. Prioritize Thursday–Sunday evening/night events, major concerts, district nightlife, OU home-game friction, and major festival windows. Standalone items must include venue/location.
rules_locked.venue_watch: Relationship and nightlife venues with current and forward-looking activity. Prioritize live music, karaoke, dancing, bar events, and late-night activity. Under a venue header, do not repeat the venue name.
rules_locked.featured_this_weekend: Weekend-forward nightlife/live-music focus. Maximum 4–6 items. Favor relationship venues, local live bands, late-night events, and ride-demand windows after dark.
rules_locked.sports_schedule: Rider-focused sports only. Prioritize Thunder home games, OU football, and other events with meaningful metro ride impact. Keep sports here unless intentionally promoted.
rules_locked.coming_up: Forward-looking only. Preserve high-value future events beyond the target slide window, especially major concerts, Thunder home games, OU home weekends, Halloween/nightlife, and relationship-venue events.
rules_locked.expired_cleanup: Remove events that end before the target slide window.
rules_locked.single_owner: A target-window event should have one primary slide-section owner to reduce repetition across What's Hot, Featured Weekend, Venue Hotlist, and Metro Sports.
